### The Basket in the Reeds
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-march-9-2023.html
Passage: Exodus 2:3
Points:
- When Moses' parents could no longer hide him, they placed him in God's hands.
- God orchestrated every detail, from the princess bathing to the infant's timely tears stirring her compassion.
- A healthy walk of faith combines practical, thoughtful action with spiritual dependence on the Lord.
- Surrendering our dearest treasures to God requires deep trust, but He honors and rewards such sacrifices.

### Put It All in God’s Hands
Author: Michael Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-january-11.html
Passage: Exodus 2:3
Points:
- Placing the basket in the river was not reckless abandonment, but a prayerful and strategically planned step.
- Divine providence guided the river's current to Pharaoh's daughter and positioned Miriam to intervene.
- Releasing what we cherish into God's keeping often demands tremendous faith and personal surrender.
- Living out active trust before our families provides a lasting spiritual example for the next generation.
